purpose: Apply an MD-topology feasibility gate before selecting eight label-independent PPARG starts for multi-start OpenMM sampling.
trigger: Stage28 exposed an untested topology failure: coordinate-complete structures can still contain internal chain gaps or an incomplete C terminus. The first Stage28 trajectory is quarantined because the source PDB contains a 19 A apparent cross-gap peptide bond.

selection.seed_rule: first passing structure in the pre-existing Stage18c max-min order
selection.addition_rule: unchanged deterministic max-min standardized pocket distance over the MD-ready pool; lexical conformer ID tie-break

interpretation_boundary: This amendment corrects the MD-topology feasibility gate and quarantines the original Stage28 trajectory. It cannot establish MD convergence, docking enrichment, QUBO superiority, quantum speedup, or quantum advantage.
